xrefcode.com / docs / cli / symbolize

$ xref symbolize

by Alexander Panasenko · xrefcode.com
On this page
  1. Usage
  2. Arguments and options
  3. Examples
  4. Provenance

Map addresses from a saved run onto the selected executable: plain address lists, perf script call chains or folded stacks. It never attaches to a process. Frames outside the executable, in shared libraries, in an ambiguous mapping or in a range without unwind information stay explicitly unresolved.

Usage

xref symbolize [OPTIONS]

Arguments and options

Options

--input <INPUT>
Saved addresses, perf script, or root-first folded stacks; '-' reads stdin.
default -
--format <FORMAT>
[possible values: addresses, perf, folded].
default addresses
--base <BASE>
Runtime address of the lowest image virtual address (not an arbitrary text mapping).
--maps <MAPS>
Saved /proc/PID/maps from the sampled process, not the current process.
--target-path <TARGET_PATH>
Original executable path as it appears in maps/MMAP records.
--pid <PID>
Process TGID to select from perf-script samples.
--build-id <BUILD_ID>
Reject a mismatch against the selected binary's build ID.
--kind <KIND>
Auto: sampled leaf is instruction IP, ancestors are return addresses [possible values: auto, instruction, return-address, static, symbol].
default auto
--max-bytes <MAX_BYTES>
Input byte budget; reading stops there and the result is marked truncated.
default 2147483648
--max-samples <MAX_SAMPLES>
Stack sample budget; reading stops there and the result is marked truncated.
default 100000
--timeout-ms <TIMEOUT_MS>
Time budget in milliseconds; reading stops there and the result is marked truncated.
default 30000
--jsonl
Stream one JSON object per sample, followed by a summary object.
--folded
Aggregate canonical root-first function stacks (bounded memory) [alias: --collapse].
--group-callers
Include exact decoded return call-sites in ancestor grouping keys.
--group-by <GROUP_BY>
Count samples by the immediate caller's call site; unknown caller stays unknown [possible values: caller].

Examples

Command
# One leaf-first address stack per line; BASE is the runtime image base.
xref -b app symbolize --input addresses.txt --base 0x555555554000
# Use the saved /proc/<pid>/maps instead of a base.
xref -b app symbolize --input addresses.txt --maps saved.maps --target-path /opt/app
# perf script call chains, grouped by caller.
xref -b app symbolize --format perf --input stacks.perf.txt --pid 1234 --group-by caller

Formats, mapping rules and output: Offline stacks and observed call evidence.

Provenance

These examples show syntax only; they are not recorded.
